what: the concave vertical edge where a taller cylinder (r8 x 15) meets a block's side (10 high), filleted r1: refused ('a vertex of the edge chain where other faces meet: both faces next to the edge must be planar'); it worked when both were the same height
method: block 20x20x10 + cylinder pi 64 15 less their overlap (half the cylinder over the block's height, pi 64/2 10). The round fills the corner between the plane x = 20 and the cylinder: its circle (r1) has its centre at (21, 10 - sqrt80), tangent to both; the region between the plane, the cylinder and that circle (polygon clipping, 8192 segments a quarter circle) times the edge's 10 mm, the block's top closing it. Graded to 1e-5 relative, as the round adds 3e-4
